annotations.title: Zoom into part of a frame

description:
Render a close-up of part of a frame (a region, or mark N of a marks render) at full resolution: real detail, seams and gaps, not enlarged pixels.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/zoom"}

bookmark_name.description: Pose from a camera bookmark (summer_engine_save_camera_bookmark (list: summer_engine_list_camera_bookmarks)). Use INSTEAD of camera_position/camera_look_at.

camera_look_at.description: Explicit pose: point the camera looks at, "Vector3(x, y, z)".

camera_position.description: Explicit pose: camera position, "Vector3(x, y, z)". Goes with camera_look_at.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees (1..179). Default: the bookmark's own, or 60.

mark.description: A label number from a marks:true render of the SAME pose and reference_size (summer_frame_nodes, or summer_screenshot framing free/bookmark at that size).

max_size.description: Longest edge of the returned JPEG in pixels (default 1024). Bigger costs more context; up to 4096 for detail work on a PC.

pad.description: Margin added around the region on each side, as a fraction of its size (0..1; default 0 for region, 0.15 for mark). The caption's widened_because says when the rendered window is larger than asked.

reference_size.description: [width, height] of the frame region/mark refer to (default [1024, 576]). Sets the zoom's aspect.

region.description: [x, y, w, h] as fractions (0..1) of the frame from the same pose, x/y from the TOP-LEFT. Use this OR mark.

save_to.description: Also write the returned image to res://.summer/shots/saved/<name>.jpg (1-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -; needs max_size <= 1024).

scenePath.description: Scene to look at, e.g. "res://levels/town.tscn" (the SAVED file). Omit for the scene open in the editor.

view.description: "beauty" (default: real environment, lights, fog, tonemap), "lighting" (light only), "unshaded" (albedo/texture only), "normals" (world normals, x red y green z blue), "overdraw", "wireframe".
